title: Visable local-practice report
description: A user's structured report that an actual immigration-office visit differed from Visable's guidance. Reports are evidence for review, never guidance: a report becomes visible only after moderation (see data/local-practice-202609.json → moderation_states) and even then is labelled by its truth layer. No personal identifiers are collected.

office.description: Office id from data/local-practice-202609.json or a free-text office name.

visit_month.description: Month of the visit (YYYY-MM). Day is deliberately not collected.

status.description: Status code if the user knows it. Optional.

evidence_available.description: The reporter says they could show a receipt, notice or officer memo on request. Nothing is uploaded.

consent.description: The reporter confirmed the text contains no passport number, ARC number, resident registration number, case number or full legal name.

x-forbidden-patterns.description: The API rejects a report when any free-text field matches these (privacy guard, mirrored in api/local-practice/report.js).

x-moderation.rule: A single report never changes guidance. A reviewed report is shown as REVIEWED_USER_REPORT; two or more consistent reviewed reports may be shown as VERIFIED_LOCAL_PRACTICE only after a maintainer marks them CORROBORATED; official notices are OFFICIAL_LOCAL_GUIDANCE.
